sources.title: Piracy monthly report June 2025
sources.text: While underway, the bosun discovered that the lock on the deck store was broken. A search was conducted, with no perpetrators found onboard. All crew members were accounted for, with no injury reported. Some ship stores including one set of SCBA, one unit of compressor for SCBA bottle recharge and two units of radio transceiver were missing. The master reported the incident to Singapore Port Operations Control Centre (POCC) via email on 17 Jun 2025. The ship was en route from Port Klang, Malaysia to Laem Chabang, Thailand.
